title: Marlowe Rewards Programme Terms: Conversion into Marlowe Rewards Notes
content:
**1. Automatic conversion.** Under automatic conversion, the nightly run converts available Marlowe Rewards points into a single Marlowe Rewards Note whenever the member's available points are at least one conversion block of 2000 points.

**2. Available points.** Available points are the points on every entry of the membership whose available date is on or before the run date. Pending earnings, whose available date is later, are excluded.

**3. Units, points and value.** 

- The number of reward units is the whole number of 2000-point blocks contained in the available points.
- The points debited are the units multiplied by 2000.
- The note value is the units multiplied by 20.00 USD.

**4. What does not convert.** Pending points never convert. A partial block never converts and is never paid out.

**5. Status.** Conversion runs only while the membership is in status active.

**6. Negative balance.** Conversion is blocked while the total points balance is below zero.

**7. Note validity.** The note's validity is the note validity, in calendar days, of the tier held on the conversion date, counted from the issue date. The note itself is issued under Gift Cards & Store Credit.

**8. Member choice.** Members cannot request conversion early, choose a different denomination or decline a conversion.

## Worked example (hypothetical ledger)

A member in status active has a total balance of 6140 points. Of these, 800 points are pending, so the available points are 5340.

- Whole blocks of 2000 in 5340: 2 units.
- Points debited: 2 multiplied by 2000, which is 4000.
- Note value: 2 multiplied by 20.00, which is 40.00 USD.
- Remaining: 1340 available points, a partial block, plus the 800 pending points. All of these stay on the membership.

## When the nightly run converts

| Status | Total balance | Available points | Conversion |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active | zero or above | 2000 or more | Yes |
| Active | zero or above | under 2000 | No (clause 1) |
| Active | below zero | any | No (clause 6) |
| Suspended | any | any | No (clause 5) |
